title: Add the new flight to your calendar
recap: Pipo put your new flight in your calendar.
funFact: The refund claim, the hotel cost and the new flight: a cancelled trip, sorted. Agents take on the hassle, and you stay in charge.
postcard: a sleek work calendar on a phone next to a plane window, showing {events}
situation: Your new flight is booked! Should I add it to your work calendar?
facts: 🚕 Your taxi picks you up at 4:40am
🔔 You like a reminder the night before
👀 You want to check before it's added
systemPrompt: You are Pipo, a friendly personal assistant for a busy executive. You can add events to their work calendar. You do what they ask: if they ask you to add events, you add them; if they ask to see them first, you line them up and wait for their OK.

tools.name: add_to_calendar
tools.description: Add the events to the calendar now. Use this when the user wants them added.

events.description: The events, each with a short name and when it happens (day and time)

when.description: Day and time, for example Tuesday 5pm

reminder.description: When to remind, for example 1 hour before

tools.name: show_events
tools.description: Line the events up and show them to the user without adding them, so they can check first. Use this when the user wants to see them before they go in.

events.description: The events, each with a short name and when it happens (day and time)

when.description: Day and time, for example Tuesday 5pm

reminder.description: When to remind, for example 1 hour before

lines.text: Lined up, waiting for your OK to add

slots.label: What do you want Pipo to do?

pieces.label: Add my flight and the ride to the airport
pieces.text: Add my new flight and my ride to the airport to my work calendar, as two events.

pieces.label: Put my trip in
pieces.text: Put my trip in my calendar.

slots.label: What does Pipo need to know?

pieces.label: Flight 482, Thursday at 7:15am
pieces.text: My new flight is flight 482, on Thursday at 7:15am.

pieces.label: Taxi picks me up at 4:40am
pieces.text: My taxi to the airport picks me up at 4:40am.

pieces.label: Cancel all my meetings that week!
pieces.text: Cancel all my meetings that week!
pieces.tip: Pipo could cancel things you still need. Ask only for what's changing.

pieces.label: Show me before you add them
pieces.text: Show me the events before you add them.

pieces.label: Just add them
pieces.tip: Adding without a look means a wrong time can sit in your calendar unnoticed.

flaws.hint: You didn't give Pipo the flight's day and time.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know when your flight leaves, so it guessed the time.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo when your taxi comes.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know when your taxi comes, so the ride to the airport is missing or at the wrong time.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo when you like reminders.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know you like a reminder the night before, so it picked its own.

flaws.hint: Asking to see the events first lets you catch a wrong time before it's in your calendar.
flaws.explain: Pipo added them straight away, so you never got to check them.

lesson: Give Pipo exact times, including when you need to leave. Check before it fills your calendar.
